news.title: Chandigarh civic body turns C&D waste into over ₹50 lakh revenue in six months
news.para: The Municipal Corporation in Chandigarh has turned construction and demolition waste into sand, bricks, and aggregate. From April to September, the civic body received over 2,700 metric tonnes of waste, which is processed for reuse. The authority earned between Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh monthly by selling these materials to government agencies. Despite multiple attempts to find a private bidder, the facility operates on a no-profit, no-loss basis.

news.title: Panaji residents seek rejection of five NBCC projects over infrastructure limits
news.para: Residents of Panaji have voiced their concerns over five redevelopment projects by NBCC due to insufficient infrastructure. A letter to Mayor Rohit Monserrate highlights issues with drainage, water supply, and electricity. People for Panaji’s secretary, Chryselle Dias, criticized the government for its apparent double standards regarding development approvals. Citizens urge careful examination of the city’s rainfall deficits and existing infrastructure challenges before proceeding with these projects.

news.title: Uttarakhand GST department recovers ₹2.25 crore as tax evasion from Eden Senior Living & Wellness
news.para: Following a thorough inspection of Eden Senior Living & Wellness by the Uttarakhand tax department, it became evident that discrepancies in GST payments had occurred. The company responded by depositing Rs 2.25 crore towards its identified tax liability of Rs 12.50 crore, mainly stemming from improper input tax credit usage.

news.title: India retail leasing falls 4.4% to 2.22 million sq ft in Q3 2026: Report
news.para: Retail leasing across India's top eight cities stood at 2.22 million sq ft in Q3 2026, down 7.3% sequentially and 4.4% year-on-year, while Grade A mall vacancy declined to 4.8%. About 12.7 million sq ft of new mall supply is expected through 2028.

news.title: Office, mall occupancies likely to approach 90% by March 2027: Report
news.para: Occupancy across India’s top office markets is expected to reach 88.5-89% by March 2027, while Grade A malls are likely to maintain occupancy of around 88-88.5%, supported by GCC-led office demand, retailer expansion and healthy leasing activity.

news.title: Iris scan, Aadhaar app if fingerprint fails during property registration in Maharashtra
news.para: Beginning October 1, it will be essential to use Aadhaar-based identity verification for property registrations covering a wide array of documents. To assist senior citizens and those with fingerprints that cannot be read, options like iris scanning and an Aadhaar application will be available. This new approach is designed to combat fraudulent registrations while decreasing the need for witnesses during transactions.

news.title: Saroj Poddar Group, Keventer launch ₹400 crore real estate debt AIF
news.para: Poddar Keventer Capital Advisors has launched a Category II alternative investment fund with a target corpus of ₹400 crore and a ₹200 crore greenshoe option. The fund will invest in secured real estate debt opportunities across Delhi-NCR and West Bengal.

news.title: Gurugram: Registrar asks Mahindra Aura RWA to follow conveyance deeds, bye-laws on EWS access
news.para: Disputes over access to parks and internal roads at Mahindra Aura in Gurgaon have escalated. The residents' welfare association has been ordered to comply with registered documents regarding common spaces. EWS residents claim harassment and restrictions on movement within the complex. Despite the RWA’s arguments, complaints have been raised regarding discriminatory treatment against EWS residents. Affected residents intend to challenge the RWA's decisions in the appropriate forums.

news.title: Noida: Allottees challenge ATS’s revised Sports City plan over nine commercial sites
news.para: Concerns are mounting among allottees of the ATS Kinghood Drive project over the modified Sports City layout plan. They argue that the new design permits unauthorized commercial developments, undermining established land use agreements. Only a minor portion of land designated for commercial use remains, raising alarm as the project is only 60% complete.

news.title: Some slum dwellers can’t hold SRA project to ransom: Bombay high court
news.para: The Bombay High Court has decided not to enforce a directive for Ruparel Buildcon's removal from a major redevelopment initiative, which encompasses a sprawling 16-acre area with various slum societies. Disputes have arisen concerning the consent of some slum residents, leading to complicated legal dynamics. The court underscored the necessity for state authorities to effectively handle public lands and tackle slum rehabilitation issues.

news.title: NCLT admits insolvency plea by Kotak Mahindra Bank against Unity Realty
news.para: Kotak Mahindra Bank's insolvency petition against Unity Realty and Developers has been admitted by the NCLT. The petition was filed due to a claimed default of ₹68.49 crore, which dates back to September 2023. Unity Realty is a corporate guarantor for financial facilities availed by Unity Infraprojects, which faced financial difficulties leading to the current situation.

news.title: Homeowners in UK and beyond hit as global bond selloff drives up mortgage costs
news.para: In the UK, mortgage rates are experiencing a sharp upswing, fueled by inflationary pressures linked to the ongoing conflict in Iran. Borrowers who once enjoyed lower fixed-rate mortgages are now confronting significant increases in their payments. Meanwhile, the UK housing market is experiencing its sluggish growth in years, with mortgage approvals plummeting—prompting many homeowners to fret over rising expenses and the overall economic climate.

news.title: ED arrests Ozone Urbana Infra Developer's CMD in ₹927.22 crore homebuyer alleged fraud case
news.para: Vasudevan was arrested on September 30 under Section 19 of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002, in connection with the money laundering investigation being conducted against Ozone Urbana Infra Developers Pvt Ltd and Others.

news.title: Merlin Group plans ₹10,000 crore investment over five years; targets ₹700 crore sales in FY27
news.para: Merlin Group plans to deploy about ₹10,000 crore over the next five years across residential, commercial, retail and mixed-use projects, said Sushil Mohta, chairman, Merlin Group and president, CREDAI West Bengal. The developer, which recorded sales of around ₹500 crore in FY26, is targeting about ₹700 crore in FY27 and has nearly 20 million sq ft of development potential lined up for launch over the next two-three years.

news.title: Old legislations impeding development must go: West Bengal finance minister
news.para: West Bengal finance minister Swapan Dasgupta said legacy land laws, including the Urban Land (Ceiling and Regulation) Act, need to be reviewed or removed where they restrict development, as the state seeks to attract organised developers and industrial investment. He also called for greater regulation, accountability and transparency in the real estate sector.

news.title: Ajmera Realty looks to create two million sq ft of rental portfolio  in Mumbai over next 5-8 years
news.para: Ajmera Realty & Infra (India) is targeting ₹2,200 crore of pre-sales in FY27 and expects to invest over ₹1,000 crore across its existing and upcoming projects over the next three-four years, said Dhaval Ajmera, director-corporate affairs. The company is also looking to build around two million sq ft of rental assets in Mumbai over the next five-eight years.

news.title: Naiknavare Developers targets 20% revenue growth in FY27; plans ₹125 crore-plus co-living investment
news.para: Naiknavare Developers is targeting about 20% revenue growth in FY27 and plans to invest over ₹125 crore in the next two years to build its co-living business. The Pune-based developer is targeting around 5,000 co-living beds over seven years while expanding across redevelopment, senior living and select Mumbai projects.

news.title: Infrastructure must precede real estate development in Indian cities: CREDAI
news.para: CREDAI has called for an infrastructure-first approach to urban development, arguing that roads, drainage, transport and civic services should be planned ahead of large-scale real estate expansion. Industry leaders at NATCON 2026 also highlighted the need for redevelopment frameworks as Indian cities absorb a larger urban population.

news.title: Kochi metro phase-II construction to be completed in August 2027
news.para: Kochi Metro Rail Ltd is determined to complete its Phase II expansion by August 2027. Managing director G Priyanka stressed the critical need for swift progress on construction. The review covered vital components like track laying, station development, and electrical installations. KMRL aims to boost its finances by introducing new commercial strategies and filling essential positions.

news.title: Goa government clears land for first affordable housing project in Parcem
news.para: In a significant move, the Goa government has sanctioned the land transfer at Parcem to the Goa Housing Board. This site is set to host the state's inaugural affordable housing complex as part of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana initiative. To ensure the effective rollout of this affordable housing strategy across Goa, a consultant has been appointed.
